_note: Factor labels and hints are seed DATA, not code. They are adapted from Exit Planning Institute worksheets; before public or paid release, confirm permission with EPI or reword them here (or in Settings) in your own language. Weights default to 1.0 so totals match the paper worksheets (132 and 66).
